channel.title: Baha Erdoğan — Engineering Notes
channel.description: Articles on AI, computer vision, engineering and technology.

item.title: Why Building an AI Startup Is So Hard: Production Reality
item.description: Why most AI startups fail once they meet production: vibe coding, inference costs nobody calculated, weak teams, short runways, and the "wrapper" trap. Notes from consulting for early-stage founders.

item.title: Will Artificial Intelligence Replace My Job?
item.description: Will AI take your job? Two questions answer most of it: is it feasible, and what does it cost? Which jobs are safer, which are at risk, and why automation may bring factories back to rich countries.

item.title: Types of Agentic AI and How to Build Your First Agent
item.description: The five common types of AI agents, what each one is good for and where each one breaks, plus a practical path to building your first agent.

item.title: What Are AI Agents or Agentic AI?
item.description: An AI agent doesn't just answer questions. It plans, uses tools and checks its own work. How agentic AI works, where it helps, and where it breaks.

item.title: Agentic AI in Depth: Planning Models, Memory and Orchestration
item.description: Part 3 of the agentic AI series: how agents plan (BDI, ReAct, ReWOO), how they use tools and memory, and the orchestration patterns that keep them reliable in production.

item.title: Agentic AI vs Generative AI: Architectural Differences and Chatbot Impact
item.description: Generative AI writes an answer; agentic AI runs a loop until a task is done. The architectural differences, the trade-offs in production, and what changes for chatbots.

item.title: From Prediction to Impact: What Artificial Intelligence Actually Means for You
item.description: AI already shapes your feed, your bank's fraud checks and your doctor's scans. What machine learning actually does in everyday life, what it costs, and how to stay in control.

item.title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Defense Technologies
item.description: Defense software is among the best-protected in the world. What happens to that protection when attackers, and defenders, have AI? Passwords, encryption and a shifting balance of power.

item.title: The Ergenekon Epic: An Ancient Turkish Legend
item.description: The Ergenekon epic retold in plain English: a defeated people hidden in a mountain valley for four hundred years, an iron mountain melted with seventy bellows, and a grey wolf that leads them out.

item.title: Mac Keyboard Shortcuts: A Practical Guide for macOS
item.description: The Mac keyboard shortcuts worth learning first, especially if you're coming from Windows: editing, Finder, screenshots, windows, text navigation, Terminal and code editors.

item.title: The Oğuz Kağan Epic: An Ancient Turkish Legend
item.description: The legend of Oğuz Kağan, the mythical ancestor of the Oghuz Turks, retold in plain English: a child who refused milk, the beast in the forest, two wives from the sky and the lake, the grey wolf, and the golden bow and silver arrows.

item.title: From Netflix to TikTok: How AI Knows What You Like
item.description: How recommendation systems at Netflix, TikTok and Spotify decide what to show you, explained without math: collaborative filtering, content-based filtering, and why your feed gets repetitive.

item.title: Are AI Models Making Us Earn Money We Don't Deserve?
item.description: When AI does in minutes what used to take a day, is your salary still deserved? Why that feeling is understandable, and why tools have never made skilled work worth less.

item.title: How to Estimate Object Speed from Video
item.description: Can you measure how fast something moves in a video without a calibrated camera or a known reference? Structure from Motion, depth networks and tracking, and where the missing scale comes from.

item.title: What's Machine Learning, Really?
item.description: Machine learning doesn't learn the way people do. It fits a mathematical function to data. A plain explanation of how that works, the three main types, and why the limits matter.

item.title: Anomaly Detection in Machine Learning: Methods and Math
item.description: How machine learning finds the rare data points that don't fit: supervised, unsupervised and semi-supervised methods, the math behind them, and the problems you run into in practice.

item.title: One of the Precious Metals: Data
item.description: Why data has become one of the most valuable resources of our time: what makes it different from oil or gold, why AI depends on it, and who gets to own it.

item.title: Why High Value-Per-Kilogram Exports Are the Key to National Prosperity
item.description: Why export value per kilogram says more about a country's prosperity than GDP does: a cheese example, the trap of cheap high-volume exports, India and Japan compared, and the window Türkiye has now.

item.title: Why Is Knowing History Important?
item.description: A quick search can tell you almost anything, but it can't give you judgement. Why knowing history, not just looking things up, makes for better decisions, clearer thinking and fewer repeated mistakes.
